dedupe_keys.name: road network graphs for betweenness centrality algorithm

description: IT4Innovations researchers publish weighted road graphs for centrality calculations in Czechia and Portugal. The Zenodo archive contains semicolon-delimited UTF-8 CSV edge lists free under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. Coverage includes Prague, Brno, Ostrava, Lisbon and Porto, plus country-wide road networks. Each row identifies a start node, end node, unique edge and length weight in metres. These graphs can benchmark shortest-path and betweenness calculations used in road-disruption simulations. Related catalogue record data-openstreetmap covers the source mapping database. The release supplies static network inputs, not traffic observations or a calibrated assignment model. Limitations include unknown extraction dates, road filtering and turn restrictions, and licence restrictions limit redistribution of modified outputs. The linked algorithm is a separate dependency whose execution was not checked. No archive was downloaded, network connectivity measured or centrality results reproduced.
